storyline.real: Hamilton leads from pole. Räikkönen, fourth after ten laps, stops last of the top four each time: mediums in the middle stint, softs for the last 17 laps. He closes on the Mercedes by more than a second a lap, passes Rosberg when his brakes fail two laps from the end, and finishes second, 3.380 s behind Hamilton.
storyline.headline: Räikkönen's late softs catch Hamilton in Bahrain

mastery.label: Win on two stops, as Räikkönen made

eras.briefing: Bahrain, 2015. Hamilton leads from pole; you run Räikkönen fourth, 8 s behind him after ten laps, with Rosberg and Vettel between you. All four of you are on softs. Ferrari can run against the grain: stop later than the Mercedes and save the fast tyres for the end.
